units.function: Tests for opt-in OpenTelemetry bootstrap, protocol selection, network-silent no-op tracing, failure-tolerant readiness/shutdown and provider-plugin span timing.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> instrumentation module -> optional OpenTelemetry API/SDK/exporters selected from environment; real SDK path is conditional and absent in this local run.
units.keyDataModels: Exporter endpoint/protocol environment, tracer/provider lifecycle, span name, parent trace context, arbitrary attributes and wall-clock start/end timestamps.
units.lifecycle: Read environment at import -> stay no-op or dynamically bootstrap optional SDK -> expose readiness/tracer -> record spans -> memoized shutdown; bootstrap failure degrades to warning/no tracing.
units.testAssessment: 13 tests passed and 2 real-SDK duration tests skipped because optional packages are unavailable. Disabled/failure paths are strong; actual export, security, redaction, sampling, backpressure and delivery behavior are not established.
units.designRationale: Make observability explicitly opt-in and operationally non-fatal while preserving a uniform tracer seam and accurate native span widths for asynchronous provider/plugin work.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs optional operational telemetry across managed and self-hosted profiles without exporting enterprise data outside authorization, blocking product startup or confusing lossy traces with durable responsibility evidence.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the network-silent default, no-op seam, optional dependency loading, accurate timestamps and idempotent failure-isolated shutdown. Add an ObservabilityPort behind Data Export Contracts, strict protocol/endpoint validation, mTLS/auth, tenant-scoped sampling, attribute allowlists/redaction, bounded queues and explicit operator receipts.
units.responsibilityConflict: Telemetry spans are lossy operational signals and accept arbitrary caller attributes; they cannot serve as evidence or responsibility records. Export without an accountable data-authorization contract could leak prompts, paths, Agent outputs or tenant identity.
evidence: 2026-08-19 focused Vitest: 13 passed, 2 skipped because optional OTel SDK was absent
units.securityFindings: HIGH egress-policy gap: exporter destination and attributes are not bound to enterprise authorization. HIGH redaction gap: arbitrary span attributes/errors are accepted without secret/content filters. HIGH production-verification gap: actual SDK/export path skipped. MEDIUM transport gap: endpoint TLS/auth/trust and unknown-protocol fail-closed behavior are absent. MEDIUM resource-control gap: sampling, retry, queue bounds and shutdown timeout are untested. MEDIUM context-integrity gap: caller-supplied trace IDs/timestamps/names lack validation in this unit.
